name: Antypas Auto Categories, SEO & Tags
author: Ioannis Antypas

sections.description:
AI publishing tools and content automations are great at writing and publishing posts on a schedule, but they almost always drop every post into one default category and leave the SEO title, meta description, and tags blank. This plugin fills all of those gaps automatically, the instant a post is published – so your blog stays organized and SEO-complete without manual cleanup.

It is tool-neutral. It hooks into the WordPress publish event itself, so it works with whatever creates the post:

  • AI blog autopilots such as Soro, Arvow, ZimmWriter, Koala, and SEOWriting.
  • Content and social automation tools such as Blotato.
  • RSS importers and no-code automations (Zapier, Make, n8n).
  • Scheduled posts, and posts you write by hand in the editor.

What it does, on publish:

  • Auto-categorize – any post that lands in your chosen inbox category (Uncategorized by default) is re-filed into the best-matching existing category, based on your category names and slugs, with optional keyword rules for precise control.
  • SEO title tag – when a post has no SEO title, one is generated from the post title, with your site name appended when it fits. Works with SEOPress, Yoast SEO, or Rank Math.
  • Meta description – when a post has no SEO description, a concise one is generated from the article opening. Works with SEOPress, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or the native WordPress excerpt.
  • Tags – when a post has no tags, relevant ones are added, drawn from the post title, your existing tag vocabulary, and any keyword rules you define. You choose how many.

Safe by design: it only ever acts on posts in the inbox category, and for titles, descriptions, and tags it only fills fields that are empty. Anything you set by hand is never changed. An optional only-this-author setting can scope it to the exact user your tool publishes as. No external calls, no tracking; deactivate and it stops, uninstall and it cleans up after itself.

For support, contact support@ioannisantypas.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or extract it into wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Auto Cat, SEO & Tags.
  4. Set the inbox category to the one your publishing tool uses (usually Uncategorized) and save.

New posts will self-file, self-title, self-describe, and self-tag from then on.
sections.faq:
Which publishing tools does it work with?

Any of them. It does not depend on a specific service – it reacts to the WordPress publish event. That includes AI blog autopilots (Soro, Arvow, ZimmWriter, Koala, SEOWriting and similar), automation tools (Blotato, Zapier, Make, n8n), RSS importers, scheduled posts, and posts written by hand.

Will it change posts I categorized or tagged myself?

No. It only acts on posts whose category is the inbox category, and it only fills title, description, and tag fields that are empty. Anything you set by hand is left untouched.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

SEOPress, Yoast SEO, and Rank Math are detected automatically for the SEO title and meta description. If none is active, the description falls back to the native post excerpt.

How are tags chosen?

From three sources combined: tags you already use that appear in the post, keywords from your optional keyword rules, and meaningful phrases from the post title. You set the maximum number of tags (default five). Posts that already have tags are skipped.

Does it send my data anywhere?

No. Everything runs locally on your site. No external calls, no tracking.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Renamed the plugin to “Antypas Auto Categories, SEO & Tags” for a distinctive, brand-prefixed name, and updated the text domain to match the new slug. No functional changes.

1.1.1

  • Hardened the settings page output by escaping all option-name attributes (esc_attr), to meet the WordPress Plugin Check security standard.
  • Corrected the Text Domain header to match the plugin slug.

1.1.0

  • Added automatic SEO title tag fill (SEOPress, Yoast, Rank Math).
  • Added automatic tag generation from the post title, existing tags, and keyword rules, with a configurable maximum.
  • Keyword rules now also guide tag selection.
  • Settings page reorganized to group the SEO and tagging controls.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: auto-categorization on publish, multi-SEO-plugin meta description fill, settings page, optional keyword rules and author scoping.
